class.name: PhysXGroundDust3D
class.brief_description: Near-field tyre dust simulated in NVIDIA Flow.
class.description: Claims the dust a [GroundSurface3D]'s tyres lift within [member near_range] of [member follow_target] and feeds it into a [PhysXFlow3D] of its own through a pool of sphere emitters that follow every sliding or spinning wheel. Flow carries it: the vehicle body and other physics bodies are solids the dust curls round, the ground wind pushes it, it is heavier than the air and fades as it settles. Its density casts a volumetric shadow on the ground. Dust lifted farther away stays with [GroundDust3D]'s grid. The flow's terrain floor reads the [GroundSurface3D]'s deformed surface, so the dust rests on ruts and berms.

members.member: How heavy the dust is in the air: the flow's [member PhysXFlow3D.smoke_buoyancy] is set to minus this, so thick dust sinks and spreads along the ground.
Off: no claim, so all dust goes to [GroundDust3D].
How fast each puff swells as it leaves the tyre (the emitters' divergence), per second.

Emitters in the pool: one per dusty wheel.
Dust lifted within this distance of [member follow_target] goes to Flow; beyond it, to [GroundDust3D].
